description: Binary heap with heap-property maintenance proof after insert/delete. Uses Z3 array + integer theory over a bounded array backing store. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/binary_heap — verified binary max-heap'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/container/bounded_array.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm and bounded_array.mm already use.

atoms.name: heap_parent
atoms.description: Parent index of node i in a binary heap stored in an array. Uses (i - 1) / 2 with i > 0 precondition.

atoms.name: heap_left_child
atoms.description: Left child index of node i in a binary heap. Returns 2*i + 1. Requires the result to fit within capacity.

atoms.name: heap_right_child
atoms.description: Right child index of node i in a binary heap. Returns 2*i + 2. Requires the result to fit within capacity.

atoms.name: heap_insert_len
atoms.description: Bookkeeping step for heap insertion: given current length and capacity, return the new length. Proves len < cap is maintained as a heap invariant.

atoms.name: heap_extract_len
atoms.description: Bookkeeping step for extract-max: given current length, return the new length (len - 1). Requires non-empty heap.
